name: Ticket turnstile gate (closed turnstile + entry railing + support pillar)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; the turnstile blocks the entry lane with the railing extending the barrier line and a pillar anchoring the far side.

offset_basis_summary: Turnstile_Closed and Railing sit in the same sheet column of the 20_Subway_and_Train_Station sheet (x288, y32 and y96), so that pair is sheet_relative. Small_Pillar lives in a separate sheet region (x304,y176) with no spatial relation to the turnstile, so its placement as a far-side structural column is hand-authored.

pieces.notes: Extends the barrier line beside the turnstile lane.
Structural column marking the far end of the gate lane.

variants.gate_state: Swap me.subway.turnstile_closed for me.subway.turnstile_opened to show an unlocked lane.
variants.pillar_optional: far_pillar is optional; drop it for a gate against an existing wall.

notes: Sheet-relative turnstile+railing pair widened into a full gate lane with a hand-placed support pillar, matching the entrance-composition pattern used by grp.subway.station_stairs.
